notes: Host receive-clock response is not absolute physical latency or a calibrated fixed offset.
SDK API true is not a fusion or accuracy acknowledgement.
Sample timestamp in control_pose is not a TX timestamp.
L is an effective value fitted against primary gyro, not independent floor-angle calibration.
Source fractions are time-weighted; safe-zone no-wheel is intentional, not failure.
motion_sessions.sdk counts and delay statistics are restricted to the issued-action envelope; Pose counts/rates cover the recorded session. The report labels full-session API totals separately.
